title: Cache Geometry
tagline: Compare set-associative mapping strategies by expected miss cost under growing working sets.

curves.label: Direct-Mapped Thrash
curves.code: for (i=0;i<n;i++){ idx=i%S; /* always one way */ if(tag[idx]!=i){ misses++; tag[idx]=i; } }
curves.name: Direct-Mapped Thrash

curves.label: 2-Way Skewed Sets
curves.code: for(i=0;i<n;i++){ a=(i*3)%S; b=(i*3+1)%S; if(!(tagA[a]==i||tagB[b]==i)){ misses++; if(tagA[a]==-1){tagA[a]=i;} else tagB[b]=i; } }
curves.name: 2-Way Skewed Sets

curves.label: Victim Cache Boost
curves.code: for(i=0;i<n;i++){ set=i%S; hit=(tag[set]==i); if(!hit){ misses++; if(victim.valid){ tag[set]=victim.val; } victim={valid:true,val:i}; } }
curves.name: Victim Cache Boost

curves.label: 4-Way Reconfigurable
curves.code: for(i=0;i<n;i++){ set=i%S; /* choose among 4 ways with lightweight reconfig */ ways=[w0,w1,w2,w3]; if(!exists(ways, i)){ misses++; replaceWay = (policy=="LRU"?lru(set):hash(i)); setWays[set][replaceWay]=i; } }
curves.name: 4-Way Reconfigurable

curves.label: Associative Perfecting
curves.code: for(i=0;i<n;i++){ /* idealized mapping with minimal conflict */ if(!seen[i]){ misses++; seen[i]=true; } }
curves.name: Associative Perfecting
